_comments: JDX / Gilhari ORM Reverse Engineering config file.
Copy this file into your project root directory and edit it for your database.
The current working directory becomes the project root.
src/, bin/, config/ subdirectories are created automatically.
Any value left blank or omitted will be prompted for interactively.
CLI flags always override values in this file.
Set 'verbose' to true (or use --verbose) for detailed progress output.
Set docker_image_name to a project-specific name (e.g. my-sakila-service) to avoid conflicts between projects on the same machine.

Set 'tables' to a comma-separated list of table names to skip the interactive selection menu, or 'all' to select every table. In --yes (non-interactive) mode, 'tables' must be set. Leave blank to select interactively.

Set 'embed_db_file_in_microservice' to true to bake the database file into the Docker image (self-contained/shippable). Only applies to file-based databases (SQLite, H2 file mode, HSQLDB file mode, Derby embedded, Excel). Default false = mount the host database directory at runtime via Docker volume (recommended — DB changes visible immediately without rebuilding).
Set 'db_type' to override the DB type inferred from jdbc_url (MYSQL/POSTGRES/ORACLE/MSSQL/SQLITE/DB2/SNOWFLAKE/MARIADB/DATABRICKS/SPANNER). Leave blank for auto-detection (recommended).
